description: Implementation of thread management utilities including setting thread priority, affinity, thread naming, and observer pattern for thread lifecycle events in the ocudu project.

classes.name: unique_thread_observer_list
classes.description: Manages a list of thread lifecycle observers, allowing addition and notification on thread creation and destruction.

classes.name: unique_thread_index_manager
classes.description: Manages allocation and release of unique thread identifiers within a fixed maximum supported number.

methods.name: thread_set_param
methods.description: Sets the real-time priority of a thread using pthreads.

methods.name: thread_set_affinity
methods.description: Sets CPU affinity for a thread based on a bitmask.

methods.name: compute_this_thread_name
methods.description: Retrieves the current thread's name using pthreads.

methods.name: print_thread_priority
methods.description: Prints the affinity and scheduling policy of a thread.

methods.name: unique_thread::make_thread
methods.description: Creates and launches a thread with specified name, priority, and CPU affinity, and manages thread lifecycle observers.
